summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on the `fix/desktop-e2e-cross-client-sync-poll` branch (PR #456), specifically addressing Copilot feedback about duplicate concurrent metadata refreshes and inaccurate test script comments.
summary.outcome: All 4 unresolved review threads were addressed: an in-flight dedup guard (`refreshing_metadata: HashSet<String>`) was added to prevent duplicate concurrent IPNS metadata refreshes, test script comments were corrected, the fuse crate compiled cleanly, and fixes were committed and pushed to the PR branch.

repo: The `CipherBoxFS` struct in `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs` already uses `HashSet<String>` fields (`prefetching`, `resolving_file_pointers`) as in-flight dedup guards — new dedup guards should follow this same pattern.
The fuse crate has pre-existing vendored `fuser` warnings that appear on every build and are not regressions.

The `dependabot/github_actions/pnpm/action-setup-6` branch had a pnpm v10 upgrade that required adding `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` to whitelist 6 packages needing build scripts to resolve `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`.
The project has both Unix (`.sh`) and Windows (`.ps1`) versions of E2E test scripts in `tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/` that must be kept in sync.

code.finding: CipherBoxFS struct uses `prefetching: HashSet<String>` for content prefetch dedup and `resolving_file_pointers: HashSet<u64>` for file pointer dedup — `refreshing_metadata: HashSet<String>` was added following this same pattern.
Metadata refresh logic lacked an in-flight guard, allowing duplicate concurrent refreshes for the same IPNS name.
Windows-specific read_ops had the same missing in-flight dedup guard as the Unix version.
Had inaccurate 'ONLY operation' comment that was flagged by Copilot and corrected.
Had the same inaccurate 'ONLY operation' comment as the .sh counterpart, corrected in the same fix.

workflow: The `/resolve-pr-comments` workflow uses GraphQL `reviewThreads` to fetch unresolved threads, then replies via REST and resolves via GraphQL mutation.

Using parallel sub-agents to implement independent fixes (dedup guard vs. comment fixes) while keeping the main context focused on orchestration is an effective pattern for multi-file PR review resolution.
When stashing work to fix another branch, the stash restore is handled automatically to return to the original working state.

friction: Finding the CipherBoxFS construction site required multiple grep attempts with different patterns (`prefetching: std::collections::HashSet::new()`, `prefetching:`, `CipherBoxFS {`, `resolving_file_pointers:`) before locating it.

The branch context was split: the pnpm fix needed to go to `dependabot/github_actions/pnpm/action-setup-6` while primary work was on `fix/desktop-e2e-cross-client-sync-poll`, requiring a stash/switch/push/restore sequence.
open_items: The `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` fix pushed to the dependabot PR branch also needs to be applied to `main` eventually — it will arrive via the PR merge but hasn't been applied directly yet.

The Windows-specific fuse files (`apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/fuse/mod.rs`, `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/fuse/windows/mod.rs`) were also modified, suggesting the dedup guard pattern needed to be applied in multiple layers of the codebase — worth verifying full coverage.
